frozen_target: Original normalized signed Hermite function-value samples, n_p>=1,k natural,L>0 finite rational executable input, q0 LSB, no phase quotient/postselection/free oracle/discarded garbage. Approximate radius is an internally charged approximation, not a substituted source.

highest_quantum_frontier.parameter_limit: Polynomial dependence is in numeric n_p and k. No unconditional n_p-only bound for arbitrarily growing k or a complete finite-bit/synthesis bound follows.

coefficient_range.claim: All-k literal source coefficient range and valid restriction range with B=(k+1)^2*2^(3k); exact natural numerator/positive-denominator representation and input-dependent power-of-two output envelopes.
coefficient_range.limits: Valid coefficient indices, denominator positivity and scalar membership are distinct domains. Output bounds are not all intermediate bits, GCD/runtime or all-k float safety. Stronger k-independent range remains unformalized.

rational_budget.claim: Computable exact rational ceiling/clog allocator with positive input/output bit bounds, actual same-list return, chronological wires/resources and conditional full signed/all-garbage error.
rational_budget.limits: Successful validation is not Sound: wrong point intervals can return Some and fail true-angle containment. Sound finite-source enclosure producer remains internal/open. This allocation spends the whole budget only on perturbing an exact list; other pipeline errors require separate allocation.
rational_budget.actual_evaluation_checks: Allocator and literal finite RY/CX return/rejection outputs reproduced; not executed Hermite source-family acceptance.

stored_qr_residual.claim: Actual stored binary64 cores and same scaled-QR return/normalizer receive exact-rational cross-Gram residual and scale-drift bounds against normalized stored raw TT, without exact-QR/orthogonality assumptions.

n64_witness.limit: Finite measured witness, not fitted asymptotics, ideal-source error or quantum acceptance.

stored_qr_residual.limits: QR work, integer/GCD/isqrt/decoding/copies/storage/serialization and peak RAM are separate from field counts. Decoder/Python-Lean refinement, ideal source, repeated compiler QR, angles and saved circuit action remain open. Large honest bounds and failures are not accuracy success; increasing certificate precision does not remove backend error.

radius_stability.claim: Actual smoothInitial global all-k Lipschitz, including k0 and both splices, with C(k)=2^(5k+2)*(k+1)^2*(2k+2)*(2k+1). Original-target normalized radius error <=2*sqrt(2^n_p)*C(k)*abs(Rhat-pi*L).
radius_stability.reuse: Literal Bernstein expansion/coefficient bounds, exp derivative bound, existing zero-order endpoint jets, exact original grid equality and midpoint reference norm floor; no caller-supplied Lipschitz/continuity/derivative oracle or phase quotient.
radius_stability.limits: No executable radius generator or pi/exp membership/refinement/runtime certificate. The sqrt dimension factor is retained; its logarithmic precision interpretation is not a compiled bit-cost theorem. Input L multiplication/size and every other numerical error remain charged. Positive domain binders are transparently stronger specialization and retained without changing sealed statements.

optional_entry_validation.behavior_change: Optional checked entry validates exact int dimensions and positive exact Fraction L/local budget uniformly before calling frozen constructor once. Zero-injection invalid budget bypass now rejects. Valid returns are the same objects with same arguments; exceptions propagate unchanged.
optional_entry_validation.rollback: Do not call optional wrapper; original numerical supplier is unchanged.
optional_entry_validation.limit: Local coefficient budget is not global epsilon. Trusted ordinary import/object model, not hostile subclass security or numerical/source correctness.

fixed_cutoff_failure.exact_result: Each finite pi interval strictly straddles 1/L; clamped candidate ceilings remain [0,1]. Actual frozen supplier and old/new entries raise rational pi interval did not separate the cutoff.
fixed_cutoff_failure.limit: Refutes successful totality of this fixed-cap implementation on all legal inputs. Not true pi equality with a rational midpoint, Hermite mathematical impossibility or a bit-complexity lower bound.

next_circuit_design.concrete_gap: Actual compile_mps prunes and repeats legacy QR, completes float matrices, expands atan2/Gray angles and exports .17g tokens. QRResidual's same returned train is not the compiler return. Old transport fixtures use a different source producer.
next_circuit_design.proposed_experiment: One actual OffsetSource n3,k1,L1 same-plan saved action, sound finite trig/matrix enclosures, rational stage surrogate and full terminal-bond readout chain. Compare full signed surrogate to literal returned D, not normalize(D); retain nonunitary amplification and all source errors.
next_circuit_design.parent_checked: Complete design read, ten source hash bindings verified; actual compiler/generator/diagnostic call path inspected. No performance or success conclusion.

audit_provenance.disclosure: All workers reused disclosed context. Reviewers are distinct from new packet authors but include upstream GlobalAssembly/QR/SafeEnclosure/RationalBudget authors or prior source/normalization reviewers. Scoped source inspection and fresh executions are not whole-chain scientific/publication independence.
audit_provenance.seal_history: Separate cycle12 signature deltas retained. Actual chronology is author-recorded, not independently reconstructed from hashes. Coefficient v3 names but does not SHA-pin v2; final result binds all retained versions. Old OffsetSource amended-during-proof seal without original snapshot remains debt, not retroactively repaired.
audit_provenance.failed_attempts: Each packet/audit retains actual API/parser/cast/probe failures. Only final actual successful gates are counted. Root binding script initially expected bindings rather than coefficient input_sha256; corrected read-only schema handling passed40 bindings. Root digest probe initially omitted required root argument; corrected invocation matched unchanged digest.

runtime_harness.scope: Protocol/runtime tests, not synthesis capability benchmark

root_aggregate_gates.proof_trust_guard: exit0;0 approved sorry,0 unapproved holes,0 source axioms; not a new exhaustive all-root axiom census
root_aggregate_gates.build_all: Not run in dirty primary: it rewrites unrelated user Robin exports. Use isolated clean integration checkout after admission readiness.

publication_and_curriculum.local_records: ThinLQ, PrimitiveBasisLE, GrayBasis, ConstructiveThinLQ retained and fresh validated
publication_and_curriculum.debt: 47 changed modules lack records;395 RobinMatrix experimental declarations remain ineligible. Reader/purification/required CI and source admission remain open.
publication_and_curriculum.textbooks: Earlier bounded Walsh/diagonal/QIT/QASC slices and shared matrix substrate retained; no whole-textbook completion or new public graph extraction claimed.
publication_and_curriculum.OAI_reference: Pinned snapshot/toolchain boundary unchanged; no unverified import upgrade.

git_and_preservation.protected_production_and_test_sources: Only previously recorded LF normalization differs from HEAD; ignore-EOL diff exit0. Proof input digest unchanged.
git_and_preservation.historical_logs: Preserved; new trials appended by existing qbe trial-log producer only

next_bounded_cohort: Seal and implement a sound finite rational radius supplier with L/input-dependent precision; no exact pi-cutoff separation assumption.
Certify actual scalar/tail and restricted-coefficient source error, all intermediate rational sizes and preprocessing costs.
Run the sealed small same-plan full saved-action experiment, then prove sound trig enclosure/stage/readout refinements; keep all garbage and literal signed semantics.
Compose radius/source/stored QR/normalizer/saved-action/physical synthesis budgets from one global epsilon; do not infer arbitrary-epsilon float64 success.
Continue bounded genuine module/source/reader admission and textbook dependencies, preserving experimental eligibility boundaries.
Integrate only admitted changes after clean required checks; perform further salvage-first branch deletion only with new exact ancestry/content/PR/worktree evidence.
